task.description: Define appliance-wide architecture constraints, storage limits, retention tiers, and trust boundaries for Linux on Intel N100.

module.description: System-wide immutable evidence pipeline: canonicalization, hashing, signing, timestamping, manifesting, retention, and auditor export bundles.

controls.How it would be automated (brief): Evidence chain: hash/sign exports, immutable storage, timestamping; generate evidence register.
controls.Evidence artifacts produced (examples): Evidence register, hashed export manifest, signed ZIP, timestamp log
controls.Notes / assumptions: On-prem appliance (N100) runs collectors via agents/APIs; some controls require org process.
